## Mark your calendar!

**Date:** 30 and 31 August, 2027

**Location:** Location TBA, München, Deutschland

<!-- [Registration](https://forms.office.com/e/dTPgBdJDwm){.btn .btn-primary} -->
**Registration is closed.**

The aim of this event is to bring together researchers from different fields of methodological research (including, but not limited to (bio)statistics, psychometrics, econometrics, bioinformatics, machine learning, quantitative methods for ecology, linguistics, etc.) who are interested in meta science on methods research, discuss how new quantitative methods are developed, evaluated and published in our respective fields, and how this process can be improved by sharing our thoughts and experiences across disciplines.

Join us to share your work, to exchange ideas, and to shape the future of meta science on methods research! 

This event is co-sponsored by the [Center for Reproducible Science and Research Synthesis](https://www.crs.uzh.ch/en.html) (CRS) of the University of Zurich, the [Swiss National Science Foundation](https://www.snf.ch/en), [Stadt Zürich](https://www.stadt-zuerich.ch/), [Kanton Zürich](https://www.zh.ch/), Hochschulstiftung Universität Zürich, and [Zurich R courses](https://www.zhrcourses.uzh.ch/en.html).
